fact: A paper for the CRVS Research Forum of March 2026 states that, per MICS6 (2019), 26% of children under five are registered nationally in Chad, and that estimates suggest under 5% of deaths are registered.
title: Analyse qualitative des obstacles à l’enregistrement des naissances et décès dans les communes de Bongor et Gounou-Gaya
publisher: Luc Ndoletar, CRVS Research Forum 2026 (Get in the Picture)
